dataset_split_policy.grouping: performer ID; all recordings by a performer stay in one partition
dataset_split_policy.warning: The grouped split prevents performer overlap within this protocol, but the Basic Pitch model may have seen GuitarSet recordings during training.

gpu_inventory.reason: nvidia-smi and rocm-smi were unavailable; this does not establish that no GPU exists

timing_protocol.first_update: wall time to first nonempty streaming update/realtime event
timing_protocol.isolation: new process per clip and repetition; model/session cold
timing_protocol.offline_latency: decode + analysis total; no exports/process startup
timing_protocol.realtime_latency: detected_at - estimated onset in input time; not hardware latency
